title: Genuine Zero Uniform Atlas Energy
description: Lean 4 formalization of the native real-camera/Genuine zero identity, faithful empirical C2--C7 camera geometry, exact cutoff-tail jets, and the finite-to-limit transverse-energy architecture. Version 0.15.0 completes the quantitative second-jet gate: it absorbs the M^(-3/2) log(M)^2 tail into fixed camerawise C_b(t)/M constants, derives a cutoff-independent six-camera second-jet stack bound, proves fixed C_curv(t)/M estimates for both finite curvature coordinates, and specializes the local Schur ledger so no external secondJetBound hypothesis remains. The derivative analysis uses no supplied height and is multiplicity-independent; the subsequent quadratic coercivity route remains the multiplicity-one sector. The release does not promote the remaining denominator floors, non-jet C/M constants, compact-region coverage, numerical evidence, or readout-domain equivalences to an unconditional confinement theorem.
